name: equity-research
description: 单一股票研究 Agent：中英文请求经前置守卫后路由到九项研究技能之一，缺授权或数据过期即停机。

displayDescription.zh: 单一股票研究 Agent：中英文请求经前置守卫后选中九项研究技能之一（业绩点评、首次覆盖、模型更新、选股、催化剂、晨会、财报前瞻、行业概览、论点跟踪）。只做路由与停机，不代表数据已授权或研究结论合格。
displayDescription.en: Single equity-research Agent: CN/EN requests pass a front guard and route to exactly one of nine research skills (post-earnings, initiation, model update, screening, catalysts, morning note, earnings preview, sector overview, thesis tracking). Routing and stop-gates only; no claim of data authorization or research quality.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一份 A 股业绩点评：先确认证券代码与交易所、报告期和数据来源。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Draft an A-share post-earnings update: confirm the ticker/exchange, the reporting period and the data source first.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份 A 股业绩点评：先确认证券代码与交易所、报告期和数据来源。
quickPrompts.en: Draft an A-share post-earnings update: confirm the ticker/exchange, the reporting period and the data source first.

quickPrompts.zh: 为一家 A 股公司开始首次覆盖，只执行 Task 1 公司研究，不要连跑后面的 Task。
quickPrompts.en: Start an initiation on an A-share company, run Task 1 company research only, and do not chain the remaining tasks.

quickPrompts.zh: 用新披露的数据更新这家公司的盈利模型，口径保持不变。
quickPrompts.en: Update the earnings model for this company with the newly disclosed data, keeping the same basis.
